posts.preview: This morning, the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations received a delegation from NUNW, TUCNA and NANLO, led by LaRRI, to brief the Committee on the workers’ position regarding the ongoing review of the Labour Act under the Ministry of Justice, Labour and Industria...
History in the making! For the first time, NUNW, TUCNA and NANLO collectively spoke with one voice, presenting a united position on the Labour Act Review and the role of the Labour Advisory Council
The Labour Movement strongly reaffirmed its collective commitment to tripartism, social dialogue and meaningful engagement among Government, employers and workers in shaping labour laws and policies
